name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails at Sunrise
source:
On the day of his long-awaited bracer exam, Nacht Weiss, an ex-jaeger in Crossbell meets a girl with an unusual outfit.

Her name is Chloe Barnett.

Chloe comes from the Liberl Kingdom to obtain her bracer qualification in Crossbell. 

Although the two have polar opposite personalities, they both undergo the bracer exam together as they head to the Geofront.

This is the beginning of an epic adventure for the rookie bracer duo, Nacht and Chloe!

[From [url=https://trailsatsunrise.itch.io/trails-at-sunrise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在等待已久的护腕考试当天，克洛斯贝尔的前猎手纳希特·韦斯遇到了一位穿着不寻常的女孩。

她的名字叫克洛伊·巴尼特。

克洛艾为了在克洛斯贝尔获得游击士资格而从利贝尔王国来到这里。

虽然性格截然相反的两人，却在前往Geofront的路上一起接受了护腕考试。

这是新晋游击手组合Nacht和Chloe史诗冒险的开始！

[来自[url=https://trailsatsunrise.itch.io/trails-at-sunrise]Itch.io[/url]]
